title: Smoky BBQ Sauce
description: A quick, oil-free BBQ sauce with a deep, savory sweetness. Simmering the ingredients helps cook out the raw tomato taste, blending the smoked paprika with molasses and mustard for a traditional flavor profile.

ingredients.notes: slightly increased to account for simmer reduction
essential for the traditional dark BBQ flavor
use a vegan version if keeping strictly plant-based

method.instruction: In a small saucepan, whisk together all ingredients until smooth: tomato paste, water, apple cider vinegar, maple syrup, molasses, Worcestershire sauce, yellow mustard, and the spices.
Place the saucepan over medium-low heat. Bring to a gentle simmer, stirring frequently to prevent scorching.
Simmer gently for 4 to 5 minutes, or until the sauce thickens slightly and the raw tomato aroma dissipates. Remove from heat and let cool before serving.

notes.title: Pairing Suggestion:
notes.content: This savory, smoky sauce makes an excellent dipping companion for [[crispyairfryercutlets|Crispy Cornflake Chicken Tenders]].

notes.title: Adjusting Consistency:
notes.content: If the sauce becomes too thick during simmering, stir in an extra tablespoon of water to reach your preferred consistency.

notes.title: Storage:
notes.content: Keep stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.
